value.rationale: Explicitly falsifies a motivating published stability–torsion conjecture for dynamical modules and identifies two natural low-dimensional minimal-side complete-bipartite families with an exact integral two-torsion Moore summand. The strong homotopy classification and precise smallest n in the family are structural, not a random isolated Betti number; the contrast to the torsion-free n6 is mathematically informative.
